posts.text:
Unsloth Desktop now supports NPUs! NPUs use 2-4x less energy per token for local models vs GPUs!

We collabed with AMD to support the current Strix, Krackan and Gorgon devices, and future AMD devices with NPUs will also be supported out of the box!

Blog: 
https://
unsloth.ai/docs/get-start
ed/install/amd/amd-npu
…
